blocks.instr: Look again. How do they say WHEN? Discuss together, then tap “Show the answer”.
task: **as a kid · at school · after high school · at 18 · in my third year at university · right out of college · in my early thirties**
**1**  Which two phrases give an age?
**2**  Which phrases are about school or university?

**3**  Which two mean «после окончания школы»? Which one means «после уроков»? (a) I did my homework after school. (b) I got a job after I left school. (c) I worked at a pizza place after high school.
**4**  Which tense do Margaret and Leo use with all these phrases? Why?
**5**  “I still don't have my own place”, “I still can't drive”: has it happened yet? Where does “still” go?
answer: **1**  **at 18** · **in my early thirties** ((в 18 — “at”, не ~~in 18~~; also: in my mid-thirties ≈ 35, in my late thirties ≈ 38–39))
**2**  **at school** · **after high school** ((US)) · **in my third year at university** ((UK)) · **right out of college** ((US: “college” = любой вуз; UK: straight out of university))
**3**  (b) **after I left school** ((UK)) = (c) **after high school** ((US)) — после окончания школы. (a) **after school** — после уроков ((каждый день, после занятий))
**4**  **Past simple** — it answers “When?”, and it's over. ((это ответ на «когда?», и это уже в прошлом))
**5**  Not yet → **still** + don't have / can't ((это правда и сейчас; “still” — перед “don't” / “can't”: не I ~~don't still~~ have))

**2**  ((В 18 я уехала от родителей.))
I left home **at 18**.
**3**  ((Сразу после вуза я нашла работу.))
I got a job **right out of college**. / I got a job **straight out of university**.
((сразу после вуза: первый вариант американский, второй британский; “right after university” — тоже верно))
**4**  ((Я познакомилась с лучшей подругой на третьем курсе.))
I met my best friend **in my third year at university**.
((на третьем курсе (UK; US: “in my third year of college”) — не ~~on the third course~~))
**5**  ((Когда ты научился водить?))
**When did you learn** to drive?
((did + базовая форма: не When did you ~~learned~~))
**6**  ((Я до сих пор не умею водить.))
**I still can't** drive.
((до сих пор не умею → “still” + “can't”: не I still ~~don't can~~))

blocks.instr: Margaret and Leo: ask and answer about them. Take turns: one asks with When did…?, the next answers from memory. Then tap the card.
blocks.tip: Ask the question first (When did + the base form), then answer from memory: her / his, he still doesn't…

cards.back: **When did Margaret start** playing the piano? — **At school.**
**When did Leo try** the guitar? — **As a kid.** He lasted about a week!
**When did Margaret leave** home? — **At 18**, with one suitcase and a radio.
**When did Leo leave** home? — Two years ago. And **he still doesn't have** his own place.
**When did Leo get** his first real job? — **Right out of college.**
**When did Margaret meet** Jean? — **In her third year at university.**
**When did Margaret last see** Jean? — **Ages ago.** She **can't remember exactly** — five years ago, maybe?
**When did Margaret buy** her first car? — **In her early thirties.**
**When did Leo learn** to drive? — He didn't! **He still can't drive.**

blocks.instr: Noughts and crosses: pick a square. Grey = could be better, green = good; a red word = use it. Say the sentence in perfect English, then tap to check. Three in a row wins!

tasks.ctx: про одну страну: были там один раз, лет десять назад
tasks.q: My husband and I ~~have visited~~ it <g>only once</g>, about ten years ago.
tasks.a: My husband and I **visited** it only once, about ten years ago.
tasks.why: “Ten years ago” — это «когда?», и это уже в прошлом → past simple. “Only once” — отлично.
tasks.turn: When did you last go somewhere new? Tell each other **two** things you remember about it.

tasks.q: I ~~'ve been~~ to an art museum <g>a week ago</g>.
tasks.a: I **went** to an art museum a week ago.
tasks.why: С “ago” — только past simple: не ~~have been~~ и не ~~was to~~ → went.
tasks.turn: When did you last go to a museum or a gallery? Name **one** thing you remember — or **one** you'd like to see.

tasks.ctx: сейчас ноябрь: спрашиваете друга о лете
tasks.q: <g>Did you</g> ~~went~~ to a concert or a festival this summer?
tasks.a: Did you **go** to a concert or a festival this summer?
tasks.why: После “did” — всегда базовая форма: did + go. Лето закончилось → past simple.
tasks.turn: Did you go anywhere special this summer? Tell each other about **one** place (even a park or a café near home).

tasks.ctx: друг спрашивает про ваши прошлые выходные
tasks.q: <g>Yeah,</g> I ~~'ve enjoyed this~~.
tasks.a: Yeah, I **enjoyed it**.
tasks.why: Выходные закончились → past simple, даже без даты. И “it”, а не “this”: о том, что уже было.
tasks.turn: How was your last weekend? Say **two** things you did.

tasks.q: I learned to ride a bike when I was a child. ^^KID^^
tasks.a: I learned to ride a bike **as a kid**.
tasks.why: “as a kid” = в детстве; так говорят чаще, чем “in my childhood”. Or: when I was a kid — тоже верно.
tasks.turn: When did you learn to swim or ride a bike? Who taught you? Tell each other **one** funny or scary moment.

tasks.q: I left home when I was eighteen. ^^AT^^
tasks.a: I left home **at 18**.
tasks.why: в 18 лет → “at 18”, не ~~in 18~~.
tasks.turn: When did you first live away from your parents — or do you still live with them? Name **one** good thing and **one** hard thing about it.

tasks.q: I found a job as soon as I graduated. ^^OUT^^
tasks.a: I found a job **right out of college**. / I found a job **straight out of university**.
tasks.why: сразу после вуза: “right out of college” (US) или “straight out of university” (UK) — выбирай свой вариант. Or: right after university.
tasks.turn: What did you do right after high school — study, work or something else? Why?

tasks.q: I met my best friend when I was a third-year student at university. ^^MY^^
tasks.a: I met my best friend **in my third year at university**. / I met my best friend **in my third year of college**.
tasks.why: на третьем курсе: “at university” (UK) или “of college” (US), не ~~on the third course~~.
tasks.turn: Where and when did you meet one of your oldest friends? Say **one** thing you did together back then.

tasks.ctx: сосед рассказывает про кражу в доме
tasks.q: <g>Where</g> did this ~~happened~~?
tasks.a: Where did this **happen**?
tasks.why: После “did” — базовая форма: did + happen.
tasks.turn: Tell each other about **one** surprising thing that happened near your home. When and where did it happen?

tasks.q: Did anybody ~~got~~ <g>hurt</g>?
tasks.a: Did anybody **get** hurt?
tasks.why: did + get, не ~~got~~.
tasks.turn: Tell each other about a small accident you saw or heard about (a bike, the kitchen…). Did anyone get hurt?

tasks.q: Did they ~~stole~~ <g>anything</g>?
tasks.a: Did they **steal** anything?
tasks.why: did + steal; “stole” — только без “did”: They stole my bike.
tasks.turn: Tell each other about a theft you heard about (on the news or near you). What did they steal?

tasks.q: I bought my first car when I was 37. ^^LATE^^
tasks.a: I bought my first car **in my late thirties**.
tasks.why: 37–39 → “in my late thirties”; 34–36 → “mid-thirties”; 30–33 → “early thirties”.
tasks.turn: What did you do in your early twenties? Name **two** things — and **one** you'd do differently now.

tasks.q: I moved to a new city when I was about 25. ^^MID^^
tasks.a: I moved to a new city **in my mid-twenties**.
tasks.why: около 25 → “in my mid-twenties” (mid- с дефисом).
tasks.turn: Where did you live in your mid-twenties? Say **one** thing you liked about it and **one** you didn't.

tasks.q: I worked in a shop when I finished school. ^^LEFT^^
tasks.a: I worked in a shop **after I left school**.
tasks.why: после окончания школы: “after I left school” (UK) = “after high school” (US). Не путай с “after school” — после уроков.
tasks.turn: What did you do after you left school? Tell each other **one** good and **one** bad thing about it.

tasks.q: I haven't been <g>to the theatre</g> ~~ages~~.
tasks.a: I haven't been to the theatre **for ages**.
tasks.why: давно не… → “haven't … for ages” (present perfect). А «сто лет назад» → “ages ago” (past simple): I went there ages ago.
tasks.turn: Name **one** thing you haven't done for ages but would like to do again. Why haven't you?

tasks.q: I lost it ~~few~~ <g>years ago</g>.
tasks.a: I lost it **a few** years ago.
tasks.why: “a few” = несколько; “few” без “a” = мало.
tasks.turn: Tell each other about something you lost a few years ago. Did you ever find it?

tasks.q: I haven't learned to drive yet. ^^STILL^^
tasks.a: **I still can't** drive.
tasks.why: до сих пор не умею → “I still can't” — это правда и сейчас. Or: I still haven't learned to drive.
tasks.turn: Name **one** thing you still don't have (a car, a dog, a garden…). Do you want it? Why or why not?
